title: Chart questions
summary: Every chart question of the Reports submenu and Ask-Report.ps1, imported from REPORT_QUESTIONS
intro: Put the caret on a routine, field, type or unit and pick a question from drag-lint > Reports, or run charts\src\Ask-Report.ps1 -Question <id> -Target <name> -Project <dproj>; you get a clickable chart and a DocInsight text answer. Needs a fresh project index, PowerShell 7, and Graphviz for the pictures.
